messages:
Olivia (People Ops): Quick update on attestation pings: starting this week we'll move to a single standardized extension request flow instead of ad-hoc DMs. If your team needs more time, submit the extension form on the intake page and include the blocking ticket. Deadlines will show the approved new date.

Devon (Eng): Is there a hard cap on extensions? Some infra teams might need 2 weeks for exports.

Olivia (People Ops): We generally approve up to 2 weeks for documented access or vendor delays. Anything longer needs director sign-off; use the same form and tick the "director review" box.

Nora (Security): Security note: extensions do not change audit sampling windows. If you extend, try to upload interim compensating evidence (screenshots, access lists) so auditors can sample something.

reminder-bot: Auto-reminder: attestation deadline in 7 days. Submit extension requests at least 72h before deadline to allow review.

Tom (Director): For teams requesting director review, please include scope, blockers, and mitigation plan in the request. I'll review within 48h. We'll prioritize teams that affect customer-facing controls.

Devon (Eng): If we have a partially complete control, should we still ask for an extension or mark partial?

Olivia (People Ops): Mark it 'partial' in the tracker and open the extension only if you expect the missing artifact to take longer than 72h. Partial + short ETA is usually enough for auditors.

Nora (Security): Quick filename tip for interim artifacts: prefix with team + 'interim' + date, e.g., billing-interim-20260701.png. That signals to auditors it's a temporary upload.

Olivia (People Ops): We'll run two office hours next Tue 10:30 PT and Thu 15:00 PT for help with extension forms and partial tagging. If you're blocked by system access, open an 'evidence-access' ticket and tag people-ops so we can escalate.

Devon (Eng): Thanks  Submitted an extension form for infra with the blocking ticket attached.

Olivia (People Ops): Got it, Devon  I'll route to Tom for director review and update the tracker when approved. Everyone else: please try to submit extension requests at least 72h before your current deadline.
